name: Bada Deo
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Bada Deo brings plateau furnace districts into a confederation through agreements on access to ore, common measures and protection of industrial routes. Local assemblies retain a stake in how those obligations are enforced. The University register proposes a connection to Formation of the Furnace Confederacy and Plateau Charter Crisis. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
